decision: KEEP name PGArbor / pgarbor; file extensions .pga and .pgabranch

checks.web search: No software product named PGArbor / PG Arbor found. Nearest: ARB Project (phylogenetics), ProcessWire 'Arbor' genealogy module — different names and domains.

postgresql_trademark_policy.pg_abbreviation: Not listed as a protected mark. Policy requires approval for marks 'or some variant of them' in product names; 'PG' is not addressed explicitly. Many community projects use 'pg' prefixes (pgAdmin, pgBouncer, pgvector).
postgresql_trademark_policy.residual_risk: LOW; optional confirmation from board@lists.postgres.ca tracked as +allie task. Docs must not call PGArbor 'PostgreSQL' or imply endorsement; use 'PostgreSQL-compatible'.

checks..pga extension: Not reserved; minor historical use exists for unrelated formats (e.g. some game/asset tooling). Files carry magic bytes, so no runtime ambiguity.

reservations: None made. No placeholder crates published (irreversible, outward-facing).
